answer.doing: Probably preparing food at the range: he cleared the snack packet, the green glass bottle and the small cup, and left wrappers or scraps and a few small ingredients next to the stove while a frying pan went on the cooktop.
answer.explanation: At 16:00 the counter held a green glass bottle, a small brown cup and a silver snack packet. By 18:00 those were gone, and there was crumpled paper or foil, a red item and a brown item. In the same interval a frying pan appeared on the left cooktop next to it, which looks like cooking. Julian cooks a lot at home and my notes say he uses this cooktop. He is home until about 16:30, before his evening shift, and Mara is usually out until about 17:30. So Julian is likely, but not certain.

answer.doing: Getting food ready on the island before leaving for work: the basket and the blue water bottle were cleared away, and an oil-type green glass bottle, a black bowl, paper towels and a dark dish were put out.
answer.explanation: At 08:00 the island held a blue water bottle, a woven basket with a towel roll and the plant. At 10:00 the bottle and basket were gone, and there was a green glass oil-like bottle, a black bowl, rolled paper towels and a dark dish. A black frying pan also appeared on the cooktop then. Julian cooks at home and is out only from about 09:30, so it was probably him. No item belongs to him for sure, though.

answer.doing: Probably setting the dining table for an evening meal or making it cozy. She put out a white pillar candle and a small white round object (maybe a second candle holder or a small bowl) next to the flower vase.
answer.explanation: At 18:00 the table held only the vase and flowers. At 20:00 a white cylinder (later noted as a white candle at 22:00) and a white round object sat beside the vase. The pictures show no item belonging to either person, so who did it is a guess from their schedules. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30. Mara is normally home after about 17:30, so she was most likely the one who set the table.

answer.doing: Someone moved things around in a pile of clutter on the floor. The white sneaker, the folded blue blanket and the black box were taken away. Camouflage pants were laid out and the jeans and glasses were moved. It looks like sorting or tidying the pile, not an event. Some of the difference may just be my camera angle.
answer.explanation: The same pile (skull, gold cuff/bracelet, jeans, camo pants, black glasses) is in every picture of this floor from 08:00 on, so it was only rearranged here. None of these items match the sheet: the glasses are black, not Mara's tortoiseshell or Julian's bronze ones. Julian may have been home between his shifts, but nothing in the pictures points to him or to Mara.

answer.doing: Making breakfast or prepping food at the island. The snack bag, mug and other items were cleared away, and a silver foil bag, a green bowl, a white milk-style carton and a blue bottle were put out.

By 12:00 a frying pan had been added, so the island was being used for food. None of the items is on either person's list. Julian is a chef who cooks a lot at home and is usually home until about 09:30, so he is the more likely person, but this is a guess.

answer.doing: Probably cooking a midday meal on the stove. The brown egg and the small grey item on the left cooktop were taken and used, and a black saucepan was put on the burner.
answer.explanation: At 12:00 (v036) the cooktop had only the brown egg and a small grey object. At 14:00 (v052) both were gone and a black saucepan was on the burner, so someone was cooking. Julian is the one who cooks a lot at home, and my notes say he uses this cooktop. A silver thermos like his sat by the sink at 10:00 and 12:00. I'm not sure it was him: he is usually at the restaurant until about 14:30, and the desk changes at 12:00 suggest Mara was home.

answer.doing: Someone moved things around on a floor that was already cluttered with clothes. The camouflage jacket and the white-and-black shoes were taken away, a black box-shaped bag with a handle was put down, and the striped sock was moved. It looks like someone picking up clothes after changing, or getting a bag ready.

Between 20:00 and 22:00, the camouflage jacket and the shoes are gone, the black bag is new, and the sock has moved. None of these things is on the people sheet for Mara or Julian. The floor was full of clothes all day, so nothing here shows which of them did it.

Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30. Mara is normally home after about 17:30, and her clear water bottle showed up on the office desk at 20:00.
